I am suing my doctors for transitioning me starting as a minor in the state of North Carolina.


A Gene Robinson (@AlBuffalo2nite)

A New York jury just awarded $2 MILLION to a young woman who underwent a double mastectomy at 16 and later detransitioned.

The jury found her psychologist and surgeon liable for malpractice.

Her case alleged that serious mental-health issues, including depression, body dysmorphia, anorexia and autism-spectrum traits, were not adequately addressed before an irreversible procedure was performed on a minor.

Now watch what happens when someone like her speaks publicly.

For years we were told regret was exceedingly rare. We were told these procedures were necessary care. We were told questioning the process itself was dangerous.

But when a detransitioner stands up and says, “This happened to me,” suddenly she becomes the problem.

That is the epistemic tell.

When evidence supports the narrative, it is celebrated.

When evidence contradicts the narrative, the person carrying the evidence gets attacked.

A jury heard the testimony. A jury examined the evidence. A jury found malpractice. And a jury put the damages at $2 million.

You don’t protect vulnerable young people by demanding silence from the ones who came back and said, “I wish someone had slowed this down.”

You protect them by listening.

#AStoneGroove #SilentMajoritySpeaks

Bro… after connecting all my Gmail accounts to Grok Bot, I don’t even need to open Gmail anymore. Today it cleaned up 2,000+ emails, and all I had to tell it was: “Mark these as read,” “Unsubscribe me from these mailing lists,” “Move these to trash,” or respond with whatever. 

I’m literally managing my inbox by texting my bot… thousands of emails cleaned up with a few simple instructions. And unsubscribing means less junk coming in tomorrow, too. This might be my favorite email hack ever. 

What a game changer.
